about: When each section of docs/AIMEAT-Feature-List.md was last read against the code it describes, which files or folders that code is (a folder means every file git tracks under it), and which promises of a refusal or a limit a test holds. pnpm check:feature-list fails when a watched file changes after the review, so whoever changed the code re-reads the section; and when a promise's sentence, its test file or the string the test must contain is gone. The watches are the folders and files the section's rows describe: the routes, services and tool catalog entries behind them, chosen so that the code under one section changes on at most about four days a week (measured with git log over 30 days on 2026-11-19), with a specific subfolder or file preferred to a whole services folder. Re-stamp after reading with: pnpm check:feature-list --record "<section heading>". A promise no test holds is rewritten in the list to what the code does, never listed here. Reasoning: aimeat/scripts/check-feature-list.ts.
